data.summary:
**When:** [Your Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase), as one of your **EINHYR HEARTHGUARD** units with **[Deep Strike](vsdata:core-ability/deep-strike)** is picked for an **[ingress move](vsdata:core-rule/ingress-move)**.

**Target:** That **EINHYR HEARTHGUARD** unit.

**Effect:** You can place the unit anywhere on the battlefield over 6" horizontally from every enemy unit, even inside the deployment zone of your opponent. It cannot declare a charge for the rest of the turn.
